about: The Web settings record 2 as 2.1 writes it under its own localStorage key, frozen for the reader release (contracts §11, 2.1-M486, 2.1-Q320): a top-level version and the settings fields beside it, a field this release does not know and a literal it does not know among them. Seeded as JSON.stringify(record) under key. Read by platform/browser-record.ts; extended, never broken.
